Id1.text: The campus of the Acharya Institute of Technology, directed by Dr.G. Prabhukumar and affiliated with the Belgaum-located Visvesvaraya Technological University, may be found at at Soldevanahalli, Acharya Dr. Sarvapalli Radhakrishnan Road, Hessarghatta Main Road, Bangalore – 560090, India. It was given 'Technical Campus' status by the All India Council for Technical Education of Mumbai.

Id2.text: The All India Council for Technical Education of Mumbai has designated the Acharya Institute of Technology, located at Soldevanahalli, Acharya Dr. Sarvapalli Radhakrishnan Road, Hessarghatta Main Road, Bangalore – 560090, directed by by Dr. G.P. Prabhukumar and affiliated with the Visvesvaraya Technological University in the city of Belgaum, as a Technical Campus.

Id3.text: The Acharya Institute of Technology is affiliated with Visvesvaraya Technological University in Belgaum. Dr. G. P. Prabhukumar is the Institute's director. All India Council for Technical Education, located in Mumbai, gave the Institute the status of Technical Campus. The campus address for the Acharya Institute of Technology is: Soldevanahalli, Acharya Dr. Sarvapalli Radhakrishnan Road, Hessarghatta Main Road, Bangalore - 560090.
